source_documents.title: An AIE Molecule Featured with Changeable Triplet Emission between Phosphorescence and Delayed Fluorescence by External force

reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.statement: The linked paper's focal emitter is consistently named ODFRPTZ and depicted in Figure 1; this is the provisional source-designation assignment for the manifest's unnamed case.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.1 visually inspected for designation only. This does not establish correspondence of its graph to the unverified legacy SMILES. The synthesis paragraph says dibenzothiophenyl reagent while discussion/figure identify dibenzofuran; resolve with SI.

reference_evidence_units.quote: However, AIE showed up when the water fraction reached 70%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF/water mixtures, 20 micromolar; Fig.2; UV excitation 365 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ODFRPTZ is weakly emissive in THF, begins increasing emission around 70% water, and shows stronger yellow emission near 550 nm at high water fractions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.2 visually inspected. No aggregate size, absolute enhancement factor or triplet assignment is obtained from these spectra alone.

reference_evidence_units.quote: restriction of the intramolecular rotation and vibration
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign aggregation-enhanced intensity to restriction of internal rotation and vibration reducing nonradiative relaxation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a proposed microscopic explanation, not direct dynamics or viscosity control. It should not imply that mechanical grinding always suppresses motion.

reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Pristine crystalline versus mechanically ground solid, 365 nm excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Grinding removes the short-wavelength band and redshifts the main band; Fig.3 XRD comparison indicates loss of crystallinity.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.3 visually inspected on p.3. Main text additionally reports reversible DCM-vapor recovery and DSC changes in SI, which were not inspected; grinding does not alone prove a specific conformer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: lifetime continuously increased from 0.4 ms at 300 K to 121.1 ms at 77 K
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Pristine crystalline powder, approximately 540 nm emission, temperature-dependent decay.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The delayed component becomes much longer lived on cooling; the source reports 0.4 ms at 300 K and 121.1 ms at 77 K, alongside a fast 8.9 ns component. No visible room-temperature afterglow is reported.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The 8.9 ns decay is reported from SI, not inspected SI. Oxygen enhances triplet sensitivity, but oxygen dependence alone does not distinguish phosphorescence from DF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: emission of ODFRPTZ crystalline powder is composed of prompt fluorescence and phosphorescence
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Temperature-dependent crystalline-powder PL and delayed spectra; main text also reports oxygen response.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign crystalline emission to prompt fluorescence plus phosphorescence using delayed spectra, lifetime increase on cooling and low-temperature afterglow.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not label all delayed emission as TADF. The text's argon/oxygen comparison and figure's air/vacuo labels differ; the reported ratio 2.2 is not treated as a calibrated gas-quenching constant.

reference_evidence_units.quote: strong intermolecular interactions (Figure S14), which effectively decrease the nonradiative decay rates
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Layered crystalline packing, main-text XRD discussion.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose that strong packing interactions protect triplet emission from oxygen/thermal deactivation and support the constrained quasi-axial PTZ conformation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Detailed stacking/SI Figs.S13-S15 were not inspected. Main Fig.6 was visually inspected; the interpretation does not independently establish excimer or H/J emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The calculated ΔEST values of isolated monomer, Dimer-1 and Dimer- 2 are 0.73 eV, 0.66 eV and 0.76 eV, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal-derived monomer and two dimers, TDDFT B3LYP/6-311+G(d,p).
reference_evidence_units.statement: Computed dimers have more candidate S1-to-Tn channels than the monomer; large S1-T1 gaps are interpreted as unfavorable for RISC, consistent with crystalline phosphorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are static state/channel calculations, not ISC/RISC rates. Fig.6 visually inspected; full Table S2/SI was not inspected. Values are not transferred to the ground amorphous material.

reference_evidence_units.quote: fluorescence has a long lifetime of 0.9 μs
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Mechanically ground powder, approximately 580-581 nm; Fig.7 delayed spectrum and decay.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Ground material has a microsecond component reported as 0.9 microseconds and a prompt 18.7 ns component; quantum yield increases from 3.24% to 18.88% after grinding.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Main Fig.7 visually inspected. Authors call the delayed band DF; no ground-powder temperature activation series is established in the inspected source, so the record does not upgrade it to independently proven TADF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: disappearance of the 1LE emission and 20 enhancement of the CT emission.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODFRPTZ (provisional source designation for case 0167)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Quasi-axial crystalline versus proposed quasi-equatorial ground conformer; assignments section.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign 428 nm to singlet LE, 540 nm to CT(ax) fluorescence plus triplet LE phosphorescence, and 581 nm to CT(eq) prompt/delayed fluorescence after grinding.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The quasi-equatorial ground-state structure is inferred from spectra, quantum yield and analogy rather than directly solved crystallography; the claimed LE/CT redistribution remains a bounded author interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: RIM is the explicit proposed explanation for solution-to-aggregate enhancement, not an assumption based only on the term AIE.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystalline constraints and grinding-induced disorder alter conformation and nonradiative/triplet pathways; this is phase-dependent, not a universal rule that tighter packing is brighter.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source explicitly distinguishes axial and equatorial CT emission and assigns their changing contribution after grinding; exact conformer identification remains inferential.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Conformation-dependent LE/CT and singlet/triplet state balance is an explicit interpretation of spectral switching. This overlaps the CT and triplet labels rather than adding an independent demonstrated cause.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal phosphorescence and ground-powder delayed fluorescence are distinguished by source state and conditions. Ground-powder DF is not asserted to be independently established thermally activated DF.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
